## Frequently asked questions

### Where is ID International Preschool?
Plot No 6, Sai Padhuka Maaligai, Vishal Nagar, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does ID International Preschool have?
Montessori Method, Play Group (1½–2½ yrs), Nursery (2½–3½ yrs), LKG & UKG, Day care (above 1½ yrs), Jolly Phonics, Dance & music, Art & craft, Library, CCTV, Transport with an attender.

### What ages do you take?
Play group from 1½ years, nursery from 2½, LKG and UKG from 3½ to 5½ years. Day care is open to children above 1½ years.

### What teaching method do you follow?
The Montessori Method, with Jolly Phonics, dance, music, art and craft as part of the syllabus.

### How do I visit ID International Preschool in Madipakkam?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 81483 52389.
